analysis.headline: Sustained higher baseline accompanied the usage increase
analysis.explanation: The bill was {{bill_total}}, up {{bill_change}}; daily usage rose {{daily_change}} across billing periods of {{feb_days}} and {{march_days}} days. Usage reached {{march_kwh}}. The constant-draw pattern includes an overnight level rising from {{baseline_night}} to {{march_night}} and a minimum draw of {{minimum_draw}}. A baseline increase of {{baseline_step}} began {{signal_start}} and lasted {{signal_days}}. Weather leaves {{weather_residual}} unexplained; the fit is weak and conditions were outside its training range, so weather is not a reliable explanation. The cause is unconfirmed.
